factions.name: New California Republic
factions.description: The New California Republic is a democratic nation based on old world values and principles. They specialize in long range combat and have multiple divisions.

factions.name: Caesar's Legion
factions.description: Caesar's Legion is a militaristic faction that follows the ideology of Caesar and seeks to conquer the wasteland through force. They specialize in melee combat and have multiple divisions.

factions.name: Brotherhood of Steel
factions.description: The Brotherhood of Steel is a technologically advanced faction known for their use of Power Armor and their commitment to preserving pre-war technology. They specialize in Energy Weapons and Power Armor.

factions.name: The Unity
factions.description: The Unity was born from the ashes of Jacobstown and seeks to Unite the wasteland through Mutification once again. They specialize in Super Mutants.

factions.name: Fiends
factions.description: The Fiends are a group of raiders and criminals who operate in the wasteland. They specialize in kidnapping, mugging, and torture.

factions.name: Great Khans
factions.description: The Great Khans are a group of raiders that have been forced to operate deep in the mountains. They specialize in hit and run tactics and can make chems.

factions.name: Desert Rangers
factions.description: The Desert Rangers are a group of veterans and survivalists who have broken off from the NCR. They specialize in Cowboy weapons and dish out Wasteland Justice.

factions.name: Van Graffs
factions.description: The Van Graffs specialize in trading Energy Weapons throughout the wasteland.

factions.name: Followers of the Apocalypse
factions.description: The Followers of the Apocalypse are a group dedicated towards healing the wasteland. They specialize in healing chems and Implants. They can also cure any ails.

factions.name: Gun Runners
factions.description: The Gun Runners specialize in Ballistic Weapon crafting and Ammo making.

mechanics.name: Character Creation
mechanics.description: Characters have a plethora of options when creating a character. Make a human, a ghoul, or a super mutant. Choose between Nightkin or Green. Supporters get access to wasteland Creatures, like the Deathclaw or Yao Gui.

mechanics.name: Leveling and Perks
mechanics.description: You can level up your character to level 40 and choose your SPECIAL, Skills, and Perks to create unique builds. Crafting, Scavenging, Combat, and more.

mechanics.name: Deep Ammo and Weapon Crafting
mechanics.description: Almost all weapons and ammo can be crafted at workbenches or reloading stations. These systems force you to repair and keep your stock up in order to fight.

mechanics.name: Combat
mechanics.description: Combat uses updated mechanics for an improved feel. You can find all weapons from Fallout: New Vegas as well as a lot from your favorite mods or older games.

mechanics.name: Faction Conflict
mechanics.description: Joining a faction lets you engage in conflicts with other factions, like raids or assaults to capture territory available in the Mojave.

mechanics.name: Capture Points
mechanics.description: Control key locations to gain advantages and resources. But factions can assault yours in order to gain control.
